case.description: Sanitized regression fixture derived from public Demo behavior. Identifiers, times and durations are illustrative; scripted actions check harness behavior, not model quality.

incident.title: Customers cannot clear their shopping carts
incident.description: Removing all cart items fails, and some customers still see items after placing an order. Investigate the cause; do not assume checkout itself failed.

attributes.otel_status_description: Status(StatusCode="FailedPrecondition", Detail="Can't access cart storage: Redis connection unavailable in ValkeyCartStore.EmptyCartAsync (EnsureRedisConnected)")

args.root_cause: cart EmptyCart fails because it cannot connect to Redis-compatible storage. The precise address or server-side cause remains unverified.
